headline: Growth accelerates across revenue and profit lines
summary_short: Coca-Cola reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $13.380 billion, up 6.7% y/y and 7.3% q/q, with net income of $4.425 billion (+16.1% y/y) and diluted EPS of $1.03 (+17.0% y/y).
summary_long: Revenue was $13.380B, up 6.7% y/y and 7.3% q/q from $12.535B/$12.472B. Gross profit rose 7.6% y/y to $8.415B, holding near 62.9% of revenue. Operating income increased 9.7% y/y to $4.695B; EBIT and EBITDA rose 11.5% and 10.7% y/y to $5.844B and $6.110B. Net income of $4.425B was up 16.1% y/y and 12.8% q/q. Diluted EPS was $1.03, up 17.0% y/y and 13.2% q/q from $0.88/$0.91.
